race.title: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com Mares' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: A case of sorts can be made for all 5 but RIDE LIKE A GIRL continued the excellent work when runner-up at Stratford 3 weeks ago and a repeat of that may well be enough. Kamille Au Kanada has an excellent strike rate and can remain very competitive in handicaps, so she's feared most. RIDE LIKE A GIRL (FR) KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR) REEL ORANGE (IRE)
